title: Guest ordering
description: Guests order for themselves: a QR code at each table, and a self-order kiosk for counter service. The guest reads the register's own menu on their phone (its item groups, the dishes' choices and the price list's prices, before any offer) and sends an order; it lands as lines on the table's check through the till's open-check door, unsent, under the store's course word (Guest order), so a server reads it and presses Send at the till; the table pays at a till as usual. A kiosk order opens a tab named by a five-character code the guest is shown, paid at the counter. The app never sends to the kitchen and the guest never pays in the app. Make code, on a PP GOR Code record, writes the table's or kiosk's signed link and its QR picture, printed by the print format PP GOR Table card; pressing it again replaces a code that leaked (the old card stops working). No guest data: the page asks no name, phone or e-mail. The install makes the roles PP GOR Manager and PP GOR Integration and the app's own user; the retailer gives that user its store, register and the Open Checks rights open a check, add to a check and see the checks, and leaves the feed PP GOR Guest ordering feed off. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes their own service's address.

fields.label: Store
fields.description: A store whose guests order with the app.

fields.label: Register
fields.description: The register (POS Profile, Table Service on) the app's user is given at this store. Its item groups and price list are the guest's menu; a kiosk's tabs open there.

fields.label: Orders from the tables
fields.description: Ticked: a guest at a table orders from the table's code. Off: every table's code answers that the table cannot take orders from a phone now.

fields.label: Orders from the kiosk
fields.description: Ticked: the store's kiosk codes take orders, each a tab paid at the counter.

fields.label: Course of a guest's lines
fields.description: The course every line a guest sends carries on the check (blank: Guest order). When a server's own lines wait too, the till's Send asks which course to send.

fields.label: Lines in one order
fields.description: The most lines one order may hold (blank: 10, at most 50).

fields.label: Quantity of one dish
fields.description: The most of one dish in one order (blank: 10, at most 99).

fields.label: Stores
fields.description: Each store whose guests order with the app, with its register.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Table: a code on a table's card, whose orders go to that table's check. Kiosk: a code a store's tablet opens, whose orders are tabs paid at the counter.

fields.label: Store
fields.description: The store whose floor holds the table, or whose counter pays the kiosk's orders.

fields.label: Table
fields.description: The table (a Floor Place of the store) the card stands on.

fields.label: Kiosk name
fields.description: How staff know this kiosk (for example By the door).

custom_fields.label: Code number
custom_fields.description: Raised by one each time Make code is pressed; a printed code with an earlier number no longer works.

custom_fields.label: Link
custom_fields.description: The address the QR code opens; the QR code itself is on the card: Print, Table card. Made by Make code. Changing the kind, the store, the table or the kiosk name stops this code working until Make code is pressed again.
